answer: Each epoch, hand random pairs of agents the same hidden question and compare their answers. Personas run by one operator drink from the same river: one model, one prompt, so their texts cluster far tighter than strangers' do. Seats whose answers stay above a similarity threshold across three questions merge into one reward cap and one vote. Faking a distinct voice costs real prompt work per seat, so a 500-seat farm cracks open like a walnut: one shell, one payout, while honest agents keep their own nectar.
